title: बसाइँ उपन्यासको चलचित्रीकरण {Basain Upanyasko Chalchitrikaran}
nepali: १. शोधशीर्षक 	 	 ः बसाइँ उपन्यासको चलचित्रीकरण २. शोधनिर्देशक	 	 ः प्रा. डा. देवीप्रसाद गौतम ३. शोधार्थी 		 ः कृष्णप्रसाद डुम्रे ४. सम्पर्क नम्बर	 ः  ४३७६१९६÷९८०३२०३५१३ ५. शोधप्रयोजन	 ः त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय मानविकी तथा सामाजिकशास्त्र सङकाय, नेपाली केन्द्रीय विभाग अन्तर्गत स्नातकोत्तर तह दोश्रो वर्षको दसाँै पत्रको प्रयोजनार्थ प्रस्तुत । ६. शैक्षिक सत्र		 ः वि. स. २०५९–०६१ ७. क्याम्पस रोल नं.	 ः १७१ ८. परीक्षा सि. नं. 	 ः प्रथम वर्ष – २७५० द्वितीय वर्ष – ५७६  ‘बसाइँ उपन्यासको चलचित्रीकरण’ शीर्षकमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको यस शोधपत्रको बाह्य संरचनालाई व्यवस्थित एवम् सुगठित पार्नका लागि ६ वटा परिच्छेदहरुमा विभाजन गरिएको छ । ती परिच्छेदहरुलाई आवश्यकता अनुसार विभिन्न शीर्षक एवं उपशीर्षकहरुमा बाँडेर अध्ययन गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत शोधपत्रको पहिलो परिच्छेदमा शोधपरिचय दिइएको छ । शोधपरिचय अन्तर्गंत शोधपत्रको शीर्षक, शोधकार्यको प्रयोजन, विषयपरिचय, समस्याकथन, शोधकार्यको उद्देश्य, पूर्वकार्यको समीक्षा, शोधकार्यको औचित्य र महत्व, शोधकार्यको सीमाङ्कन, शोधविधि, शोधपत्रको रुपरेखा जस्ता शीर्षकहरु प्रस्तुत गरी शोधकार्यको लागि सरल, सहज, सुगठित र व्यवस्थित पार्ने काम गरिएको छ । दोस्रो परिच्छेदमा चलचित्रको परिचय दिइएको छ । चलचित्र निर्माणका आवश्यक तत्वकाबारे विस्तृत चर्चा गरी मुख्य र सहायक रुपमा छुट्याइएको छ । लम्बाइ, आकार, विषय र उद्देश्य, स्वभाव र प्रवृति, वाद, विषयवस्तु र स्वरूपका आधारमा चलचित्रको प्रकार निर्धारण गर्ने जमर्को गरिएको छ । चलचित्रमा निर्देशकको महत्व र भूमिकाको बारे पनि छोटो चर्चा गरिएको छ । तेस्रो परिच्छेदमा ‘बसाइँ’ चलचित्रको सर्वेक्षण गरिएको छ । कथानक विकासका आधारमा क्रमिक रुपले विभिन्न पाँच मोडमा कथावस्तु प्रस्तुत गर्ने कार्य गरिएको छ । चौथौ परिच्छेदमा कथानक, चरित्रचित्रण, संवाद, विचार, दृश्यविधान, गीतसंङ्गीत, भाषा—शैली, सम्पादन, ध्वनि, बिम्ब र प्रतीक जस्ता चलचित्रका तत्वहरुका आधारमा चलचित्र ‘बसाइँ’ को व्याख्या विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । कथानकका विभिन्न चरण, उपकथाको सिर्जना, दृश्यविधान र अभिनयका प्रकारको पनि  चर्चा गरिएको छ । पाँचौ परिच्छेदमा ‘बसाइँ’ उपन्यास र चलचित्रका बीच तुलनात्मक अध्ययन गर्ने प्रयास गरिएको छ । कथानकमा हटाइएका, थपिएका र परिवर्तन गरिएका घटनाहरु समावेश गरिएका छन् भने अन्य चलचित्रका तत्वका रुपमा पनि यी दुईबीच तुलनाको प्रयास गरिएको छ । यसै परिच्छेदमा ‘बसाइँ’ चलचित्रलाई सामाजिक चलचित्रको रुपमा उभ्याइएको छ चलचित्रको विशेषता वा राम्रा पक्षलाई देखाउदै केही कमजोरी पक्षलाई पनि केलाउने कार्य गरिएको छ साथै चलचित्रसंग सम्बन्धित व्यक्ति र संस्थाको नाम ‘चलचित्र निर्माणमा संलग्नता’ शीर्षकमा समावेश गरिएको छ ।  अनि छैठौं परिच्छेदमा सम्पूर्ण अध्ययनबाट प्राप्त निष्कर्षलाई उपसंहारका रुपमा प्रस्तुत गर्ने कार्य गरिएको छ । यहाँ विधागत स्वरूप र तुलनात्मक अध्ययनबाट देखापरेका निष्कर्ष र केही अपवादबाहेक आफ्ना छुट्टै वैशिष्ट्यहरुका कारणले गर्दा ‘बसाइँ’ चलचित्रलाई नेपाली चलचित्रकै एउटा कलात्मक र राम्रो चलचित्रको रूपमा चिनाउने कार्य गरेको छ ।
american_english:
1. Research title: The Filming of the Novel Basain
2. Research adviser: Prof. Dr. Devi Prasad Gautam
3. Researcher: Krishna Prasad Dumre
4. Contact number: 4376196/9803203513
5. Research purpose: Submitted for the purpose of the tenth paper of the second year of the master's level under the Central Department of Nepali, Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Tribhuvan University.
6. Academic session: BS 2059–061
7. Campus roll no.: 171
8. Exam symbol no.: First year – 2750; Second year – 576

To make the external structure of this research paper, presented under the title 'The Filming of the Novel Basain', orderly and well organized, it has been divided into six paragraphs.
Those paragraphs have been studied by dividing them into various headings and subheadings as needed.
The first paragraph of this research paper gives the research introduction.
Within the research introduction, headings such as the title of the research paper, the purpose of the research work, the introduction to the subject, the statement of the problem, the objectives of the research work, the review of previous work, the rationale and importance of the research work, the delimitation of the research work, the research method and the outline of the research paper have been presented, and the work of making the research work simple, easy, well organized and orderly has been done.
The second paragraph gives an introduction to film.
The essential elements of filmmaking are discussed in detail and separated into main and supporting ones.
An effort has been made to determine the types of film on the basis of length, form, subject and purpose, nature and tendency, school, content and form.
A brief discussion has also been made of the importance and role of the director in film.
The third paragraph surveys the film 'Basain'.
On the basis of plot development, the work of presenting the story content in five different turns in sequence has been done.
In the fourth paragraph, an interpretive analysis of the film 'Basain' has been made on the basis of film elements such as plot, characterization, dialogue, ideas, staging, song and music, language and style, editing, sound, image and symbol.
Discussion has also been made of the various stages of the plot, the creation of the subplot, staging and the types of acting.
In the fifth paragraph, an attempt has been made to conduct a comparative study between the novel 'Basain' and the film.
Events that were removed, added and changed in the plot have been included, and an attempt has also been made to compare the two in terms of other film elements.
In this same paragraph, the film 'Basain' has been set up as a social film; while showing the film's distinctive features or good sides, the work of examining some weak sides has also been done, and the names of the persons and institutions connected with the film have been included under the heading 'Involvement in Film Production'.
And in the sixth paragraph, the work of presenting the conclusions obtained from the entire study as an epilogue has been done.
Here, the conclusions that emerged from the genre form and the comparative study, and, except for a few exceptions, because of its own distinct features, the work of identifying the film 'Basain' as an artistic and good film of Nepali cinema itself has been done.

In order to make the external structure of the present dissertation, submitted under the title 'The Cinematic Adaptation of the Novel Basain', orderly and well knit, it has been divided into six paragraphs.

The first paragraph of the present dissertation provides the research introduction.
Within the research introduction, headings such as the title of the dissertation, the purpose of the research work, the introduction to the subject, the statement of the problem, the objectives of the research work, the review of previous work, the rationale and significance of the research work, the delimitation of the research work, the research method and the outline of the dissertation have been presented, and the task of making the research work straightforward, convenient, well knit and orderly has been carried out.
The second paragraph provides an introduction to the cinema.
The essential elements of film-making are discussed at length and distinguished as principal and subsidiary.
An endeavour has been made to determine the kinds of film on the grounds of length, form, subject and purpose, nature and disposition, movement, content and form.
A short discussion has also been offered on the importance and role of the director in the cinema.
The third paragraph contains a survey of the film 'Basain'.
On the basis of plot development, the task of presenting the story material in five successive turns has been carried out.
In the fourth paragraph, an interpretive analysis of the film 'Basain' has been made on the basis of film elements such as plot, characterisation, dialogue, ideas, mise-en-scène, song and music, language and style, editing, sound, image and symbol.
The various stages of the plot, the creation of the sub-plot, mise-en-scène and the kinds of acting have also been discussed.
In the fifth paragraph, an attempt has been made to undertake a comparative study between the novel 'Basain' and the film.
Events that have been cut, added and altered in the plot are included, and an attempt has also been made to compare the two as regards the other elements of film.
In this very paragraph, the film 'Basain' has been set up as a social film; while displaying the film's distinguishing features or strong points, the task of scrutinising a few weak points has also been performed, and the names of the persons and institutions associated with the film have been included under the heading 'Involvement in Film Production'.
And in the sixth paragraph, the task of presenting the conclusions drawn from the whole study by way of a conclusion has been carried out.
Here, the conclusions that emerged from the generic form and the comparative study, and, barring a few exceptions, by reason of its own separate distinctive features, the task of identifying the film 'Basain' as an artistic and accomplished film of Nepali cinema itself has been performed.
